description: DF-0001 boundary cases for usage colour, shared by the server (src/server/mobileCapacityRoutes.ts) and the web console (dashboard/console/accounts-model.js). tests/unit/usage-tone-parity.test.ts feeds every case to both sides. resetInPast: the limit's reset time has passed since the reading. countsAsTop: the limit can decide the account's tone and usage line.
